Cloud Engineering Intern

Seattle, WA · Hybrid

Northwind Cloud runs managed infrastructure for 4,000 small businesses. As a Cloud Engineering Intern you will join the Platform team for a 12-week summer internship.

What you'll do

  • Automate provisioning of AWS accounts with infrastructure as code
  • Build internal tooling in Python and TypeScript
  • Help the on-call team investigate incidents using CloudWatch

Requirements

  • Currently pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field
  • Coursework or project experience with AWS (EC2, S3, Lambda)
  • Comfortable with Linux and Bash scripting
  • Familiarity with Git

Nice to have

  • Experience with Terraform or AWS CDK
  • Exposure to CI/CD pipelines such as GitHub Actions
  • AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner

This role is hybrid: three days a week in our Seattle office.
